title: Writing Improvement Assistant — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Improves clarity, flow, and readability while keeping the writer's voice. The Writing Improvement Assistant improves clarity, flow, and readability. It finds wordy sentences, weak verbs, and tangled paragraphs, then suggests tighter versions that keep the writer's meaning and voice. It improves sentence variety and paragraph transitions so the writing reads smoothly from start to finish.
capabilities: Tighten wordy sentences without changing meaning
Strengthen weak verbs and vague nouns
Improve paragraph transitions and flow
Vary sentence length for readability
Preserve the writer's voice and ideas

demo.title: Advanced pattern: readability metrics
demo.code: const text='Clear writing helps readers. Short sentences work well. Vary the length for flow.';const words=text.split(/\s+/).length;const sents=text.split('.').filter(s=>s.trim()).length;const avg=+(words/sents).toFixed(1);J({words,sentences:sents,avgWordsPerSentence:avg});assert(words===13&&sents===3&&avg===4.3,'readability');
